question: On the proposed site plan, where are the 8 proposed buildings (Buildings 1-8) located relative to the overhead electric lines shown on the existing conditions survey? Are any buildings within 30 feet horizontally of any overhead utility poles or conductors?
checklistItemText: Buildings and permanent structures do not maintain minimum 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors
regionHint: compare proposed building locations to utility poles/lines from Sheet 4
classifierReasoning: The agent is asking for horizontal distance measurements between proposed buildings and overhead electric infrastructure (poles/conductors), which directly supports the clearance compliance check required by the checklist requirement.
